description:
Build a direct booking link on praegant.net, optionally pre-filled with dates, party and apartment.

Use when the guest has decided and just wants the link, or wants to book without a price check. Bookings
are always completed by the guest on praegant.net (no commission) — this connector never books, reserves
or takes payment by design. check_availability already returns a booking link per free apartment, so
call this only when no availability result is at hand. Dates are optional (YYYY-MM-DD); without them the
link opens the booking page.
Behaviour: read-only, no availability check, instant. Returns text plus structuredContent (booking_url,
inquiry_url, phone, email).

adults.description: TOTAL number of guests aged 18+ in the whole party — also for groups larger than one apartment (the tool plans the apartments). Guests aged 0-17 go into children.
adults.title: Adults

apartment.description: Apartment number such as '12' or '#16'; empty or 'all' = all online-bookable apartments; '17' = Studio #17 (on request only)
apartment.title: Apartment

check_in.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD; leave empty for the plain booking page
check_in.title: Check In

check_out.description: Optional date YYYY-MM-DD; leave empty for the plain booking page
check_out.title: Check Out

children.description: Ages of ALL children 0-17, comma-separated, e.g. '8,15'; empty if none. Ages change price and tourist tax (charged from age 17).
children.title: Children

language.description: Answer language: 'de' (default) or 'en' — use the language of the conversation. Text and card are always in the same language.
language.title: Language

name: get_booking_link

booking_url.description: Booking page on praegant.net, pre-filled when dates are given

title: Get Booking Link
